name: ai-notice
title: AI notice
description: One quiet line under an AI composer saying the AI can be wrong, with an optional link the app supplies.
docs: One quiet line under an AI composer saying the AI can be wrong, with an optional link the app supplies. Do: Keep the notice to one small centred line under the composer, always present. Don't: Turn it into a banner, a callout box or a toast — it is there every time, so it stays quiet. Do: Leave it in muted ink, which passes 4.5:1 in every theme. Don't: Lighten it further with opacity — a disclaimer people cannot read does not inform them. Use alert when something has actually gone wrong and needs the person to act. Use ai-badge when one piece of content was made by AI and needs labelling where it sits.
